issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation omits the phrase 'εν ανδρι' (in a man), which specifies that the judgment is through/by a man. The current Vietnamese phrasing 'bởi một người' (by a person) appears at the end of the sentence as a subordinate clause, but it fails to capture the direct prepositional relationship 'εν ανδρι' which qualifies the manner/agent of the judgment in the Greek structure.
